en: Black-and-white vintage postcard showing a small town nestled in a hilly, forested landscape. In the foreground are fenced gardens and trees; behind them stand several gabled houses and other village buildings. At the right, a steam train with smoke billowing from its locomotive crosses on a slightly elevated track near the houses. The scene opens onto rolling fields and wooded hills in the background. Red printed German text at the top identifies the location as Geising in the Saxon Ore Mountains and refers to the town park (Stadtpark).
